global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and vibrant green onions floating atop. Served in a classic blue-and-white bowl, it rests on a red table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Red table surface with smooth texture, slightly reflective, showing subtle wood grain pattern and faint shadow lines.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue floral patterned rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu broth is creamy, pale yellow, with visible noodles, green onions, red peppers, and pork chunks floating in its rich, textured surface.
regions.spoon: White plastic spoon with smooth surface, slightly curved bowl, and faint embossed text near the base.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows pale pinkish-white meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven, cooked surface texture.
